overview: Grieg's End is the shattered domain of Grieg Veneficus, once Luclin's greatest architect and now a vessel of cosmic madness.
history: Grieg’s mind was broken by Luclin’s influence, twisting his fortress into a labyrinth of warped geometry. His psychic imprint still warps the halls, creating spatial anomalies and maddened constructs.
hooks: Spatial distortions intensify near the Mindcore.
Grieg’s illusions manifest as hostile phantoms.
Warped constructs patrol corridors that shift unpredictably.
A psychic scream echoes through the region, altering nearby zones.
